1. About RichMind

RichMind is a platform that provides and sells digital educational products and content, which may include educational courses, videos, PDF files, digital books, educational materials, and other digital products covering topics such as relationships, personal development, success, wealth, the law of attraction, and related subjects.

The content, features, access period, and other characteristics of each product may vary from one product to another.

To create an account and use RichMind's services, you must be at least 16 years old, unless the laws applicable to your place of residence require a higher minimum age for using the services, entering into contracts, or purchasing products.

If applicable law establishes a higher minimum age, that higher age requirement will apply.

Certain products may have separate age restrictions due to the nature or content of the product. Where applicable, the relevant age restriction will be stated on the product page.

3. Creating an Account

Creating an account is required to purchase products from RichMind.

You are responsible for providing accurate and valid information and for maintaining the security of your account and login credentials.

Your account is personal to you. You may not share, sell, rent, transfer, or allow another person to use your account.

Sharing your account with another person in any form is strictly prohibited.

If unauthorized use, account sharing, or abuse of an account is detected, RichMind may restrict, suspend, or terminate access to the account.

4. Purchases and Payments

Payments for RichMind products may be processed through Tribu or other payment providers used by RichMind.

RichMind may not directly receive or store complete payment information, such as card details, where such information is processed by the applicable payment provider.

After successful payment confirmation, the purchased product will be made available to the customer through the RichMind system and may be delivered by email and/or made available through the customer's account.

5. Successful Payment but No Product Delivery

If your payment has been successfully completed but the purchased product has not been automatically delivered, you should contact RichMind Support.

After reviewing the payment and your account information, RichMind will, where the transaction is confirmed, add the purchased product to your account or provide access through an appropriate delivery method.

RichMind products are primarily digital and educational products.

Part Two — RichMind Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

19. Affiliate Program

The RichMind Affiliate Program allows approved individuals to promote RichMind products through their unique Affiliate links and receive commissions on eligible purchases.

Participation in the Affiliate Program is subject to approval by RichMind.

Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance into the program.

20. Affiliate Links

Each Affiliate may receive unique links for RichMind products.

When a customer enters the website through a valid Affiliate link, RichMind may track that visit and attribute an eligible purchase to the relevant Affiliate according to the applicable attribution rules and tracking period.

Affiliates may not manipulate, alter, disguise, or misuse their Affiliate links.

21. Attribution Period

Under the current version of the program, the initial Affiliate tracking period is 30 days, unless a different period is specified for a particular product or campaign.

RichMind may change this period in the future.

If a customer enters through a valid Affiliate link and completes an eligible purchase within the applicable tracking period, that purchase may be attributed to the relevant Affiliate.

Purchases made outside the applicable attribution period, or purchases that cannot be validly attributed by the tracking system, may not generate a commission.

22. Future Purchases by Existing Customers

Under the current RichMind model, the fact that a customer previously entered through an Affiliate link or made a previous purchase does not, by itself, automatically assign all future purchases made by that customer to the same Affiliate.

Each purchase will be evaluated according to the attribution rules and tracking system active at the time the purchase is made.

RichMind may change its treatment of future or repeat purchases in the future.

23. Commission Rates

RichMind's commission rates are not fixed.

Commission rates may generally range from 30% to 50%, but RichMind may determine or change the commission rate separately for each product, campaign, or period of time.

The applicable commission rate at the time of the eligible sale will be used for calculation.

RichMind reserves the right to change commission rates for future sales.

24. Commission Approval and Payment Period

Commissions may be subject to a review period that considers payment status, refunds, cancellations, fraud, and other relevant factors.

The current review and approval period may be approximately 7 to 30 days, and RichMind may change this period in the future.

Commissions shown as Pending are not considered final or guaranteed commissions until they have been approved.

25. Commission Settlement

At present, Affiliate commissions are settled by RichMind through payment methods determined by management or support.

The settlement method, timing, and process may change in the future.

Affiliates do not have an automatic right to withdraw commissions or demand immediate payment before the commission becomes eligible for settlement.

26. Self-Referral and Personal Purchases

Affiliates may not use their own Affiliate link to make personal purchases, generate commissions for themselves, or circumvent RichMind's pricing or commission structure.

Purchasing through one's own Affiliate link is considered Self-Referral and is prohibited.

RichMind may invalidate commissions arising from such transactions.

The following may constitute Affiliate abuse or violations of these Terms:

Affiliates are responsible for the content they personally publish on websites, social media, channels, videos, messages, or any other media.

Affiliates must not make false claims, guaranteed-income claims, guaranteed-success claims, or promises of specific outcomes regarding RichMind products.
